name: Isolated Split Hand-Split Foot Malformation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical diagnostic criteria for isolated SHFM

criteria.description: Presence of median clefts of the hands and/or feet with absence of central digits
Absence of associated syndromic features or systemic anomalies
Radiographic evidence of aplasia or hypoplasia of central rays of hands and/or feet
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance with variable expressivity

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of median clefts of hands and/or feet with absence of central digits confirmed clinically and radiographically, without syndromic features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not required

imaging: Radiographs showing median cleft with aplasia or hypoplasia of central metacarpals and metatarsals
Absence of central phalanges in affected digits
genetic: Autosomal dominant inheritance pattern with variable expressivity
other: Clinical examination revealing characteristic split hand and foot malformations
Absence of systemic or syndromic features

distinguishingFeatures: Associated cleft lip/palate or facial anomalies
Localized absence of skin rather than limb malformation
No median clefts or digit absence

redFlags: Presence of systemic anomalies suggesting syndromic SHFM
Severe functional impairment of hand or foot
Family history of syndromic limb malformations
references: Klopocki E, et al. Split-hand/foot malformation: clinical and molecular advances. Eur J Hum Genet. 2012
